- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Levenshulme Bee Network is a community-led project aimed at improving public transportation and active travel infrastructure in Levenshulme, Manchester.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Real Food Wythenshawe project is a community-led initiative that improves access to healthy and affordable food in Wythenshawe, involving community gardens, food co-operatives, and education programs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Hulme Community Garden Centre is a social enterprise providing gardening and horticultural training for local residents, selling plants and urban agriculture tools, with profits reinvested into the local community.
